- Recommended baseline: 24 x A100-equivalent GPUs (64GB class) in a Dedicated pool to meet steady with 1.5x buffer.
- Peak capacity: plan for staged increase to 60 GPUs (to cover 2.5x burst headroom) over 8–12 weeks post-launch.
- Procurement reality: OEM lead for new 64GB-class units is currently ~12–16 weeks from PO; custom warranty or rack integration can add 2–3 weeks.
- Options to mitigate risk: 1) short-term cloud reserved instances (we can broker ACME Cloud blocks) to cover pilot; 2) staggered hardware deliveries (ship 40% of units first); 3) consider 48GB SKU + quantization options to reduce unit count and shorten lead-time if DeltaSKUs are constrained.

I'll loop in Ben (sales) and Monica (onboarding) to coordinate PO timing and credits. We'll prepare an SOW with explicit delivery SLAs and an emergency cloud-backfill clause.

Action items for today:
- Ben: confirm commercial cadence (commit/credit structure) so Maya can take to procurement.
- Monica: draft an onboarding headcount and timeline to absorb staged capacity.
- Karthik: I'm CC'ing you separately for quantization/throughput tradeoffs — can you validate whether 48GB with INT8 path gets us within 10–15% of 64GB perf?
